items.title: Edward "Noon" Johnson Interview, 1960-05-28
items.q: And I liked other guitars, like Johnny St. Cyril, he was around, the time before he left, he would go up to country. Yes I knew him.

ctx.x: When he was with Sam Morgan, I'd like to see that sometime. I'll dig it up there. Who were the best guitar players when you were young, when you were starting out? Who did you like to hear on guitar? Can you remember some of the best guitar players?

Well see for ragtime, I don't think there was nothing, nobody in town, but he was Walter. He was a little bit of a ragtime and blues player. That kind of wasn't, I don't think nobody in town before, at that time. And I liked other guitars, like Johnny St. Cyril, he was around, the time before he left, he would go up to country. Yes I knew him.
They all used to give Walter the credit.
